awards.title: René Descartes National Scholarship
awards.description: Awarded a $25,000 scholarship by the Faculty of Mathematics at the University of Waterloo. Recipient of one of approximately 10 scholarships, ranging from $12,000 to $25,000, given to students for distinguished academic standing and outstanding mathematical achievements.

awards.title: CMO Repêchage Qualifier
awards.description: Qualified for the Repêchage mathematics paper by placing in the top 125 for the COMC.

awards.title: 3x AIME Qualifier
awards.description: Qualified for the American Invitation Mathematics Examination three times in grades 10, 11, and 12.

awards.title: Chess Awards
awards.description: - Team 1st at 2023 & 2024 Ontario School Team Chess Championships - 2nd at 2024 Ontario Chess Challenge - Tied 3rd at 2023 Canadian Chess U20 Junior Open - Tied 4th at 2023 Canadian Youth Chess Championships - 3rd at 2023 Ontario Chess Challenge - 3rd at 2022 Ontario Chess Challenge - 2200+ CFC Classical Rating, 2000+ FIDE Classical Rating

posts.text: I'm thrilled to announce that I will be joining Shopify as a Software Engineering Intern this Winter! I'm super excited for the opportunity to write code that powers global commerce for millions of merchants worldwide. Looking forward to diving into full-stack engineering, tackling high-scale infrastructure challenges, and learning alongside an incredible team of builders. Huge thanks to everyone who supported me through the recruiting process.

Nelson Kang and I placed 2nd in Dominion Dynamics' WHITEOUT track at Hack the North. The challenge was to find one unlit boat hidden somewhere in an Arctic strait with a random spawn point. You get a quadcopter, a fixed-wing plane, and two sensor towers, and you have to find the boat and keep tracking it. I’m thrilled to announce that I’ll be joining Ciena this summer as a Software Development Intern! I’ll be working with the Optical Planning Tool Link Engineering and Algorithms team, where I'll be focused on modernizing their software base. I'm incredibly grateful for the chance to apply my interests in software and problem-solving to the optical communications space. A huge thank you to Christopher Wah and the rest of the team for the opportunity, and to everyone who has supported me throughout
